author: Madrang
install_msg: Installed AgentEliza from [RedCogs repository](https://github.com/madrang/RedCogs). Load the cog, set the API key with `[p]eliza setkey`, then check the connection with `[p]eliza status`
name: AgentEliza
short: AI agent harness for Discord, over an OpenAI-compatible chat API.
description: Connects AI agents to Discord servers. Replies to mentions and direct messages with answers generated through an OpenAI-compatible chat API. Defaults to Kimi Code (api.kimi.com); the host, model, and key are configurable. MCP servers give the agent tools.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-user long-term memory, conversation summaries, usage stats, and rate windows, managed by the AI agent and the bot admins. All of it is deleted on an end-user data request.
